assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original full-body adult anime fantasy RPG character cutout for a WeChat character-collection game. Requested portrait PNG 1024 x 1536, genuine transparent RGBA background. Normal adult proportions about seven heads tall, precise controlled colored line art, two or three crisp cel-shaded planes, restrained highlights, elegant readable silhouette. Ivory and midnight navy clothing, pale gold small accents and limited cyan energy details, consistent with a refined blue-white fantasy anime game roster. No chibi, no toy-like 3D, no photorealistic or gritty texture, no existing franchise character. Fully clothed practical outfit. Both eyes, all limbs and both boots clearly visible, anatomically coherent hands and joints. Front three-quarter standing pose with face turned toward viewer; no extreme foreshortening or airborne pose. Keep the COMPLETE character, hair, all held equipment and both feet within the central 76 percent of the canvas width and height: at least 12 percent truly empty transparent margin on ALL FOUR sides. Scale the whole character down to make room for the weapon. Background alpha exactly zero, opaque painted character interior, soft alpha only on thin antialiased outer edges. No floor, cast shadow, mist, halo, aura, particle effects, scenery, checkerboard, background gradient, text, labels, borders, watermark or UI. One character only, one pose, no alternate views. Male adult ranger, about 27, lean athletic build, short tousled ash-brown hair, teal eyes and calm alert expression. Short ivory shoulder cape fastened on one shoulder over a fitted high-collar navy scout jacket, navy full-length trousers, practical calf-high boots, small pale-gold buckles, one cyan clasp. A compact quiver with only three visible arrow fletchings sits behind the opposite shoulder. One hand holds a SINGLE elegant navy recurve bow down beside his body, pale-gold bow tips and one clearly continuous fine taut bowstring; the other hand rests naturally open beside the belt. No loose arrow, no drawn bow. The curved bow and short cape provide a distinct asymmetrical narrow silhouette. Keep every bow tip inside the safe margin.
